name: massive-passive-master-polish
description: Gentle UADx Manley Massive Passive MST mastering polish on a stereo 2-bus: broad WIDE-bandwidth low-shelf weight + a touch of low-mid de-mud + broad air shelf — the classic 'everything sounds better' musical tilt. WIDE bandwidths (bw 1.0) keep the moves broad/gentle; subtle dB; crest essentially held (it's EQ, not dynamics). Measured on the Watercolors drum loop (peak-normalized A/B): band_ratio_low 0.798->0.829 (low weight), low-mid 0.176->0.153 (390 Hz de-mud), centroid 1593->1688 (a touch of air), tilt -2.71->-2.69 (~held), crest 14.63->14.08 (held), TP -0.98 dBTP.
intended_for: a near-final stereo mix / 2-bus that wants subtle broad mastering EQ (low weight + air + a hair of low-mid clarity); the colour insert BEFORE the limiter, not a limiter
plugin_build: uaudio_manley_massive_passive_m.vst3 (UADx native MST build — renders headless & processes offline; the /Components/UAD Manley Massive Passive MST.component AU twin PASSES THROUGH offline, do not use it). UADx native = no-iLok lineage here, but re-verify changed:true elsewhere.
notes: EVERY engaged band needs its enable set to BOOST or CUT (default is OUT = band removed from circuit). enable/shape are STRING enums -> the apply-vst-chain float dict can't set them; this MUST go through apply_vst_preset.py.
Set BOTH ch1* and ch2* identically (even with ctrllink LINKED) so the render EQs both channels regardless of how Pedalboard mirrors the link.

GAIN dial 0-11 is NONLINEAR and BANDWIDTH-COUPLED: the dB you get = gain x bandwidth. WIDE bandwidth (bw 1.0) keeps these moves broad and gentle (a g4.4 wide low shelf is only a couple dB but spans the whole low end).

This is the MASTERING version (MST): stepped/detented controls + a precise +-2.5 dB / 0.5-step make-up trim (ch1gain/ch2gain). It's a clean EQ (~0.13% THD at unity) -> a tonal polish, NOT a limiter; hand the result to render-mastered / [[fabfilter-pro-l-2]] for loudness.
